policy: Organic Facebook two distinct posts per app per Philippine-local day; only verified Astramate and Keepry features, no ETA marketing, exact official website and product links, finite approved bank with no repeats.

posts.copy: Cargo stowage factor: volume and weight must agree. Astramate helps you work through the entered figures, view the calculation, and review your result before relying on approved vessel data.
Draft at forward and aft marks tells a more useful story together. Review simple mean draft and trim in Astramate, with the working visible for an independent check.
A compass reading is not automatically a true bearing. Use Astramate's Compass Error tool with your observed reading and externally verified true bearing or approved azimuth.
Planning a hold? Explore Astramate's cargo volume, cargo weight, and usable hold volume calculations. Enter the correct units and verify against your ship's approved information.
TPC and MCTC belong in a proper draft-and-trim calculation, not a guess. Explore the applicable tools in Astramate, then validate every operational result independently.
Loading calculations have multiple moving parts: stowage factor, cargo weight and hold capacity. Keep the supporting calculations together with Astramate.
Understanding the effect of a trim change requires the right vessel particulars. Astramate provides supported draft and trim calculation aids with visible working.
Deviation, gyro error and variation are different concepts. Explore Astramate's compass conversion and error tools for study and number checks, with verified inputs.
Bulk cargo: compare entered cargo volume and weight against available hold space using Astramate's supported cargo and hold-utilization tools.
Need to review GM and free-surface inputs? Astramate includes supported stability-related calculation aids. These never replace approved loading and stability information.
Stowage factor and available hold volume can change your cargo estimate. Astramate puts the calculation steps within reach when you need to review them.
Compass-to-true and true-to-compass conversions depend on sound inputs. Astramate lets you see the working instead of treating a number as a black box.
Aft draft, forward draft, mean draft and trim each answer a different question. Review the supported calculations in Astramate with clear input fields.
When reviewing cargo figures, consistency of units matters. Explore Astramate's cargo-weight, cargo-volume and tank-volume calculations, then verify the results.
